---
title: "Forecast analysis"
---

```{r}
source("R/weather.R")
payload <- fetch_weather()
hourly <- hourly_frame(payload)
daily <- daily_frame(payload)
hourly$score <- outdoor_score(hourly)
```

## Outdoor conditions

The score favours temperatures around 20°C, lower rain risk and lighter winds. It is an aid to planning, not a weather warning.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(head(hourly, 48), aes(time, score)) +
  geom_area(fill = "#22d3ee", alpha = .28) + geom_line(colour = "#67e8f9", linewidth = 1) +
  ylim(0, 100) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Outdoor score") + theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Seven-day outlook

```{r}
knitr::kable(transform(daily, sunrise = format(sunrise, "%H:%M"), sunset = format(sunset, "%H:%M")), digits = 1,
  col.names = c("Date", "Sunrise", "Sunset", "Low °C", "High °C", "Rain %", "Wind m/s", "Conditions"))
```

## Hourly weather heatmap

```{r}
today_date <- as.Date(Sys.time(), tz = weather_config$timezone)
heat <- hourly[as.Date(hourly$time) == today_date, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(heat)) heat <- head(hourly, 24)
heat <- heat[as.integer(format(heat$time, "%H")) >= 7 & as.integer(format(heat$time, "%H")) <= 22, , drop = FALSE]
heat_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(hour = heat$time, variable = "Temperature °C", value = heat$temp),
  data.frame(hour = heat$time, variable = "PoP %", value = heat$pop),
  data.frame(hour = heat$time, variable = "Rain mm", value = heat$rain_mm),
  data.frame(hour = heat$time, variable = "Cloud cover %", value = heat$clouds),
  data.frame(hour = heat$time, variable = "UV index", value = heat$uv_index),
  data.frame(hour = heat$time, variable = "Wind m/s", value = heat$wind_speed)
)
heat_long$hour_label <- format(heat_long$hour, "%H:%M")
heat_long$variable <- factor(heat_long$variable, levels = c("Temperature °C", "PoP %", "Rain mm", "Cloud cover %", "UV index", "Wind m/s"))
ggplot(heat_long, aes(hour_label, variable, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "#0b1220", linewidth = .4) +
  facet_grid(variable ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#102a43", high = "#67e8f9", na.value = "#263449") +
  labs(x = "Local time", y = NULL, fill = "Value") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), strip.text.y = element_blank(), panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(.25, "lines"))
```
